Emily Esten

digital projects for the public

Emily Esten (they/them) brings documentation, training, and coding together to help others succeed. In Esten’s varied work experience - from project lead to curator, educator to site developer - their primary focus has been shaping collaborations, training, and programming for community-oriented tech work.

Emily previously worked at Knowledge Futures and University of Pennsylvania Libraries. They currently serve as a representative on the Executive Council for the Association for Computers and the Humanities. Previously, they served on the Board of Directors for the National EMP Network. In addition to their day-to-day work, Emily is a freelance site developer and arts critic.

Contact them at estenemily+website at gmail dot com or message them on Linkedin.
